40001340.author: पदार्थः
40001340.content: सहलक्ष्मण: together with Lakshmana, राघव: Rama, विश्वामित्रवच: words of Visvamitra, श्रुत्वा having listened, परमम् great, विस्मयम् astonishment, गत्वा having obtained, अथ thereafter, विश्वामित्रम् addressing Visvamitra, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40001340.author: Translation
40001340.content: On hearing the words of Viswamitra, Rama along with Lakshmana, filled with astonishment said to him:

40001341.author: पदार्थः
40001341.content: ब्रह्मन् O Knower of Brahma, त्वया by you, कथितम् is narrated, परमम् great, इदम् this, गङ्गावतरणम् descent of Ganga, पुण्यम् sacred, सागरस्य ocean's, पूरणम् replenishment, अत्यद्भुतम् exceedingly wonderful.

40001341.author: Translation
40001341.content: "O Knower of the Brahman this story narrated by you relating to the descent of the sacred Ganga and the fullness of the ocean  (due to Ganga's fall) is very wonderful".

40001342.author: पदार्थः
40001342.content: तदा then, तस्य Rama, सौमित्रिणा सह together with Lakshmana, शुभाम् holy, विश्वामित्रकथाम् the story narrated by Visvamitra, चिन्तयानस्य while thinking, सा that, सर्वा completely, शर्वरी night, जगाम passed away.

40001342.author: Translation
40001342.content: Then Rama along with Lakshmana spent the whole night reflecting on the auspicious story narrated by Viswamitra.

40001343.author: पदार्थः
40001343.content: तत: afterwards, अरिन्दम: the destroyer of enemies, राघव: Rama, विमले clear, प्रभाते early morning, कृताह्निकम् after completing daily religious and spiritual rites, महामुनिम् great ascetic, विश्वामित्रम् addressing Visvamitra, वाक्यम् words, उवाच said.

40001343.author: Translation
40001343.content: Thereafter, the progeny of the Raghus, the destroyer of enemies (Rama) addressed Viswamitra in the clear early morning after Viswamitra had completed his routine rites:

40001344.author: पदार्थः
40001344.content: महातप: O Great performer of austerities, परमम् supreme, श्रोतव्यम् fit to be listened, श्रुतम् has been heard, भगवती glorious, रात्रि: night, गता has passed, तव your, इमाम् this, सर्वाम् complete, कथाम् story, चिन्तयत: pondering over, नौ for both of us, इयम् this, रात्रि: night, क्षणभूतेव like a moment, सम्वृत्ता has turned out to be.

40001344.author: Translation
40001344.content: "O Noble ascetic we have heard this great story worthy to be listened. As we both lay pondering over the entire story (narrated by you), the glorious night passed off just like a moment.

40001345.author: पदार्थः
40001345.content: सरिताम् among rivers, श्रेष्ठाम् excellent, पुण्याम् holy, त्रिपथगाम् flowing in three directions, नदीम् river Ganga, तराम let us cross over, सुखास्तीर्णा spread comfortably, पुण्यकर्मणाम् of men of pious acts, ऋषीणाम् saints, एषा this, नौ: boat, भगवन्तम् you venerable, इह here, प्राप्तम् had arrived, ज्ञत्वा knowing, त्वरितम् speedily, आगता हि has come.

40001345.author: Translation
40001345.content: We will cross over Ganga, the best of rivers, the sacred river that flows in three directions.This boat of pious saints which is well laidout has come here swiftly, having come to know that you, O Venerable one have arrived".

40001346.author: पदार्थः
40001346.content: सरिताम् among rivers, श्रेष्ठाम् excellent, पुण्याम् holy, त्रिपथगाम् flowing in three directions, नदीम् river Ganga, तराम let us cross over, सुखास्तीर्णा spread comfortably, पुण्यकर्मणाम् of men of pious acts, ऋषीणाम् saints, एषा this, नौ: boat, भगवन्तम् you venerable, इह here, प्राप्तम् had arrived, ज्ञत्वा knowing, त्वरितम् speedily, आगता हि has come.

40001346.author: Translation
40001346.content: We will cross over Ganga, the best of rivers, the sacred river that flows in three directions.This boat of pious saints which is well laidout has come here swiftly, having come to know that you, O Venerable one have arrived".

40001347.author: पदार्थः
40001347.content: तस्य महात्मन: of that illustrious, राघवस्य Rama's, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा having heard, सर्षिसङ्घ: accompanied by hosts of sages, सराघव: together with Rama and Lakshmana, सन्तारम् to cross over, कारयामास made (arrangements).

40001347.author: Translation
40001347.content: Hearing the words of noble Rama, he (Viswamitra), accompanied by hosts of sages besides Rama and Lakshmana made arrangements to cross (the river).

40001348.author: पदार्थः
40001348.content: उत्तरं तीरम् northern bank, आसाद्य having reached, तदा then, ऋषिगणम् groups of sages, सम्पूज्य having paid homage, गङ्गाकूले on the bank of river Ganga, निविष्टा: encamped, ते they, विशालां पुरीम् city of Vishala, ददृशु: beheld.

40001348.author: Translation
40001348.content: Having reached the northern bank, they paid homage to the sages encamped on the bank of  Ganga and beheld the city of Vishala.

40001349.author: पदार्थः
40001349.content: तत: subsequently, मुनिवर: best among ascetics, Visvamitra, सह राघव: together with Rama and Lakshmana, तदा then, रम्याम् enchanting, दिव्याम् splendid, स्वर्गोपमाम् like unto heaven, विशालाम् towards Vishala, नगरीम् city, तूर्णम् speedily, जगाम went.

40001349.author: Translation
40001349.content: Thereupon Viswamitra, the best of ascetics, accompanied by Rama and Lakshmana soon proceeded towards the enchanting and splendid city of Vishala comparable to heaven.

40001350.author: पदार्थः
40001350.content: अथ thereafter, महाप्राज्ञ: great intellectual, राम: Rama, प्राञ्जलि: भूत्वा with folded palms, महामुनिम् eminent ascetic, विश्वामित्रम् Visvamitra, उत्तमाम् excellent, विशालां पुरीम् about the city of Vishala, पप्रच्छ enquired.

40001350.author: Translation
40001350.content: Thereafter great intellectual, Rama, with folded palms enquired of eminent ascetic Viswamitra, about the excellent city of Vishala.

40001351.author: पदार्थः
40001351.content: महामुने O Distinguished ascetic, विशालायाम् in this city of Vishala, अयम् this, राजवंश: royal lineage, कतर: whose, श्रोतुम् to listen, इच्छामि I am desirous, ते भद्रम् may you prosper, मे to me, परम् great, कौतूहलं हि is my curiosity.

40001351.author: Translation
40001351.content: "O Distinguished ascetic, which royal dynasty is ruling this city of Vishala? Could you tell me? Great is my curiosity. May you prosper"

40001352.author: पदार्थः
40001352.content: मुनिपुङ्गव: preeminent among ascetics, तस्य रामस्य Rama's, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा having listened, विशालस्य city of Vishala's, पुरातनम् ancient, तत् that, आख्यातुम् to relate, समारेभे commenced.

40001352.author: Translation
40001352.content: Viswamitra, preeminent among ascetics, hearing the words of Rama commenced to relate the history of the ancient city of Vishala.

40001353.author: पदार्थः
40001353.content: राम O Rama, शक्रस्य Indra's, शुभाम् auspicious, कथाम् legendary story, कथयत: being related by me, श्रूयताम् may be heard, अस्मिन् देशे in this country, यत् what, वृत्तम् had happened, तदपि that also, शृणु you may listen.

40001353.author: Translation
40001353.content: "O Rama hear the auspicious legend of Indra. Listen, too, what had happened to this country.

40001354.author: पदार्थः
40001354.content: महाभाग राम O Blessed Rama, पूर्वम् formerly, कृतयुगे in Krita yuga, दिते: पुत्रा: sons of Diti, अदितेश्च sons of Aditi, महाबला: highly powerful, वीर्यवन्त: possessed of valour, सुधार्मिका: highly virtuous (used to live).

40001354.author: Translation
40001354.content: O Blessed Rama in kritayuga, the sons of Diti were very strong and those of Aditi were spirited and righteous.

40001355.author: पदार्थः
40001355.content: तत: then, नरश्रेष्ठ O Best among men, महात्मनाम् of the illustrious, तेषाम् for them, अजरा: free from old age, अमराश्चैव free from death, निरामया: free from disease, कथम् how, स्याम we will be, बुद्धि: आसीत् a thought came.

40001355.author: Translation
40001355.content: O Best among men a thought came to those illustrious ones, 'how can we be  free from old age, death and disease'?

40001356.author: पदार्थः
40001356.content: राम O Rama, चिन्तयताम् while they were reflecting over this matter, तेषाम् for them, महात्मनाम् noble ones, बुद्धि: a thought, आसीत् came, क्षीरोदमथनम् churning the ocean of milk, कृत्वा having made, तत्र from there, रसम् nectar of immortality, प्राप्स्याम we will obtain.

40001356.author: Translation
40001356.content: "O Rama While the noble sons were reflecting over this matter an idea flashed across their minds to get nectar by churning the ocean of milk.

40001357.author: पदार्थः
40001357.content: तत: there upon, अमितौजस: those men who were very powerful, मथनम् to churn, निश्चित्य having decided, वासुकिम् Vasuki, योक्त्रम् as rope of the churning rod, कृत्वा having made, मन्दरम् Mandara mountain, मन्थानम् as churning rod, कृत्वा having made, ममन्थु: churned.

40001357.author: Translation
40001357.content: Thereupon, having decided to churn (the ocean mind) those very powerful ones, made Vasuki, (the great snake), as a rope and Mandara mountain as the churning rod.And started churning it.

40001358.author: पदार्थः
40001358.content: अथ thereafter, वर्षसहस्रेण in a thousand years, योक्त्रसर्पशिरांसि the hoods of the serpent made as rope, तत्र there, अतिविषम् virulent poison, वमन्ति vomitting, शिला: rocks, दशनै: with teeth, ददंशु: had bitten.

40001358.author: Translation
40001358.content: After a thousand years, the hoods of the snake made as rope vomitted venom and started biting the rocks of the Mandara mountain with their teeth.

40001359.author: पदार्थः
40001359.content: अग्निसङ्काशम् resembling fire, हालाहलमहाविषम् virulent venom known as HalaHala, उत्पपात was sprung up, तेन by that, सदेवासुरमानुषम् with devatas, asuras, mortals, सर्वम् entire, जगत् world, दग्धम् was burnt.

40001359.author: Translation
40001359.content: Therefrom was produced halahala, virulent venom resembling fire.The entire universe  consisting of devatas, asuras and mortals was burnt down.

40001360.author: पदार्थः
40001360.content: अथ then, देवा: devatas, शरणार्थिन: seeking refuge, महादेवम् great god, शङ्करम् the god causing happiness, पशुपतिम् lord of all living beings, रुद्रम् to Rudra, जग्मु: had gone, त्राहि त्राहि इति save us, save us, तुष्टुवु: they extolled.

40001360.author: Translation
40001360.content: The devatas sought refuge in the great god Rudra who causes happiness, the Lord of all living beings. 'Save us, Save us', the cried.

40001361.author: पदार्थः
40001361.content: तत: thereupon, प्रभु: lord, देवदेवेश्वर: the overlord, who is god of gods, देवै: by devatas, एवम् in this way, उक्त: having been spoken, तत: thereafter, शङ्खचक्रधर: bearing the conch and discus, हरि: Hari, अत्रैव here itself, प्रादुरासीत् appeared.

40001361.author: Translation
40001361.content: Thereupon, Hari the Lord of celestial beings extolled by the devatas appeared bearing the conch and discus.

40001362.author: पदार्थः
40001362.content: हरि: Hari, स्मितं कृत्वा having smiled, शूलभृतम् god bearing the Trident, एनं रुद्रम् addressing Rudra, उवाच spoke, सुरश्रेष्ठ O Chief of celestials, दैवतै: by devatas, मथ्यमाने while churning, यत् whichever, पूर्वम् earlier, समुपस्थितम् is produced, त्वदीयं हि is yours, सुराणाम् among devatas, अग्रज: असि were born earliest, प्रभो O Capable one, इमाम् this one,    अग्रपूजाम् the first offering to the most distinguished, मत्वा thinking, इदम् this, विषम् venom, गृहाण receive.

40001362.author: Translation
40001362.content: Hari, smiling said to the tridentbearing Rudra "O Chief of celestial beings you were born the earliest among the devatas. Therefore, while churning the ocean whichever is produced first shall be offered to you. Considering it the first offering, O Lord accept this venom."

40001363.author: पदार्थः
40001363.content: हरि: Hari, स्मितं कृत्वा having smiled, शूलभृतम् god bearing the Trident, एनं रुद्रम् addressing Rudra, उवाच spoke, सुरश्रेष्ठ O Chief of celestials, दैवतै: by devatas, मथ्यमाने while churning, यत् whichever, पूर्वम् earlier, समुपस्थितम् is produced, त्वदीयं हि is yours, सुराणाम् among devatas, अग्रज: असि were born earliest, प्रभो O Capable one, इमाम् this one,    अग्रपूजाम् the first offering to the most distinguished, मत्वा thinking, इदम् this, विषम् venom, गृहाण receive.

40001363.author: Translation
40001363.content: Hari, smiling said to the tridentbearing Rudra "O Chief of celestial beings you were born the earliest among the devatas. Therefore, while churning the ocean whichever is produced first shall be offered to you. Considering it the first offering, O Lord accept this venom."

40001364.author: पदार्थः
40001364.content: सुरश्रेष्ठ: excellent among devatas, इति in this manner, उक्त्वा having spoken, तत्रैव there alone, अन्तरधीयत vanished, स: Shiva, देवतानाम् devatas', भयम् fear, दृष्टवा having seen,    शार्ङ्गिण: वाक्यम् Visnu's word, श्रुत्वा having heard, घोरम् dreadful, हालाहलविषम् HalaHala venom, अमृतोपमम् treating it as nectar, जग्राह received.

40001364.author: Translation
40001364.content: Visnu, the highest among the devatas having the spoken, vanished. Siva who had heard Visnu's words and seen the fear of the gods received that  dreadful halahala treating it as nectar.

40001365.author: पदार्थः
40001365.content: देवेश: lord of devatas, भगवान् venerable, हर: Siva, देवान् devatas, विसृज्य leaving behind, जगाम had gone, रघुनन्दन O Descendent of Raghu, तत: then, सर्वे all, देवासुरा: devatas and asuras, ममन्थु: churned.

40001365.author: Translation
40001365.content: Lord of the gods, venerable Siva went away to his abode leaving behind the devatas. O Descendant of Raghu then all the devatas and asuras resumed churning.

40001366.author: पदार्थः
40001366.content: अनघ O Sinless one, अथ after that, मन्थान: पर्वत: mountain Mandara used as churning rod, पातालम् to Patala, प्रविवेश entered (sank down), तत: thereupon, सगन्धर्वा: along with gandharvas, देवा: devatas, मधुसूदनम् Vishnu, तुष्टुवु: extolled.

40001366.author: Translation
40001366.content: 'O Sinless one after the mountain (Mandara) used as churning rod sank down to nether world (patala) the devatas along with the gandharvas invoked Visnu'.

40001367.author: पदार्थः
40001367.content: महाबाहो O Strong armed one, त्वम् you, सर्वभूतानाम् for all living beings, गति: ultimate refuge, विशेषेण specially, दिवौकसाम् for devatas, अस्मान् us, पालय protect, गिरिम् mountain, उद्धर्तुम् अर्हसि fit to lift it.

40001367.author: Translation
40001367.content: "O mightyarmed Visnu you are the ultimate refuge for all living beings, specially for the devatas. Protect us, you (alone) are fit to lift up the Mandara mountain".

40001368.author: पदार्थः
40001368.content: हृषीकेश: controller of sense organs, हरि: Visnu, इति these words, श्रुत्वा having heard, कामठम् रूपम् form of tortoise, आस्थित: assuming, पर्वतम् mountain, पृष्ठत: on its back, कृत्वा having made, तत्र there, उदधौ in the ocean, शिश्ये reclined.

40001368.author: Translation
40001368.content: Having heard these words, the controller of the sense organs, Visnu, assumed the form of a tortoise reclined in the ocean supporting the mountain on its back.

40001369.author: पदार्थः
40001369.content: लोकात्मा omnipresent, पुरुषोत्तम: supreme Purusha, केशव: Visnu, देवानाम् devatas, मध्यत: amidst, स्थित्वा standing, पर्वताग्रे on the peak of mountain, हस्तेन with his hand, आक्रम्य occupying, ममन्थ churned.

40001369.author: Translation
40001369.content: Visnu, the Supreme being, the soul of the universe standing amidst the devatas took hold of the peak of mountain with his hand and continued to churn the ocean.

40001370.author: पदार्थः
40001370.content: अथ there after, वर्षसहस्रेण in thousand years, सदण्ड: holding staff, सकमण्डलु: with water pot (carried by ascetics), धन्वन्तरिर्नाम named Danvantari, सुवर्चस: of high lustre, अप्सराश्च apsaras, पूर्वम् in the begining (came out).

40001370.author: Translation
40001370.content: In this way thousand years rolled by. In the beginining came out Dhanvantari holding a staff and a water pot (carried by ascetics) and apsaras of high lustre.

40001371.author: पदार्थः
40001371.content: मनुजश्रेष्ठ O Best among men, अप्सु waters, निर्मथनात् churning, तस्मात् रसात् from that essence, वरस्त्रिय: excellent women, उत्पेतु: emerged, तस्मात् for that reason, अप्सरस: apsaras, अभवन् became.

40001371.author: Translation
40001371.content: O Best among men excellent women emerged out of the essence produced by churning of waters. Therefore they are known as apsarasas.

40001372.author: पदार्थः
40001372.content: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, सुवर्चसाम् highly lustrous, तासाम् अप्सराणाम् those apsarasas, षष्टि: कोट्य: sixty crores, अभवन् produced, तासाम् their, या: परिचारिका: those attendants, असङ्ख्येया: countless in number.

40001372.author: Translation
40001372.content: O Kakutstha there appeared sixty crore highly lustrous apsarasas. Their  attendants were countless in number.

40001373.author: पदार्थः
40001373.content: सर्वे all, ते देवदानवा: devas or danavas, ता: them, न परिगृह्णन्ति स्म did not accept in marriage, अप्रतिग्रहणात् unmarried as they were, ता: सर्वा: all of them, साधारणा: belonging to all, स्मृता: have been called.

40001373.author: Translation
40001373.content: Neither devas nor danavas accept them in marriage. Unmarried, all of them have been regarded as belonging to all.

40001374.author: पदार्थः
40001374.content: रघुनन्दन O Joys of Raghus, Rama, तत: thereafter, वरुणस्य Varuna's, कन्या daughter, वारुणी Vaaruni, परिग्रहम् seeking consort, मार्गमाणा searching, उत्पपात fell out.

40001374.author: Translation
40001374.content: O Joy of the Raghus (Rama) thereafter Varuna's daughter Varuni (goddess of wine) came out searching for a consort.

40001375.author: पदार्थः
40001375.content: राम O Rama, तां वरुणात्मजाम् that Varuni, दिते: Diti's, पुत्रा: sons, न जगृहु: did not accept, वीर O heroic one, अनिन्दिताम् blemishless, ताम् her, अदिते: सुता: sons of Aditi, जगृहु:   received.

40001375.author: Translation
40001375.content: O Rama while Diti's sons did not accept the unblemished Varuni, O heroic one, the sons of Aditi did.

40001376.author: पदार्थः
40001376.content: तेन for that reason, दैतेया: sons of Diti, असुरा: Asuras (without wine), अदिते: Aditi's, सुता: sons, सुरा: Suras, सुरा: devatas, वारुणीग्रहणात् for having accepted Vaaruni, हृष्टा: (प्रमुदिताः च) आसन् became glad.

40001376.author: Translation
40001376.content: For that reason, sons of Diti were called asuras. Aditi's sons were known as suras. Devatas grew exceedingly glad for having Varuni.

40001377.author: पदार्थः
40001377.content: नरश्रेष्ठ O Foremost among men, उच्चैश्श्रवा: Ucchaishravas, the celestial horse,  हयश्रेष्ठ: best of horses, कौस्तुभम् Kausthubham, मणिरत्नं च best among Jewels, तथैव and also, उत्तमम् excellent, अमृतम् nectar, उदतिष्ठन् arose (out of foam).

40001377.author: Translation
40001377.content: O Foremost among men (Rama) ucchaishravas, the best of horses (the celestial horse), kausthubham, the best jewel and also nectar came (from churning).

40001378.author: पदार्थः
40001378.content: राम O Rama, अथ thereafter, तस्य कृते for it's sake, महान् great, कुलक्षय: आसीत् destructin of race took place, तत: thereafter, अदिते: Aditi's, पुत्रा: sons, दिते: Diti's, पुत्रान् sons, असूदयन् killed.

40001378.author: Translation
40001378.content: O Rama the race of devatas and daityas suffered great destruction because of (their fight for) that nectar. Thereafter Aditi's sons, the devatas killed Diti's sons, the daityas.

40001379.author: पदार्थः
40001379.content: वीर O Heroic Rama, सर्वे all, असुरा: asuras, राक्षसै: सह along with rakshasas, एकत: on one side, अभ्यागमन् joined, त्रैलोक्यमोहनम् striking confusion (delusion) among the three worlds, महाघोरम् violently dreadful, युद्धम् battle, आसीत् took place.

40001379.author: Translation
40001379.content: O Heroic Rama all the asuras along with the rakshasas joined on one side. A violent and a dreadful battle which threw the three worlds in to a great confusion, ensued.

40001380.author: पदार्थः
40001380.content: यदा when, सर्वम् everything, क्षयं गतम् was perished, तदा then, महाबल: endowed with great power, स: विष्णु: Vishnu, मोहिनीम् Mohini form (elusivedelusive ), मायाम् illusion (maya), आस्थाय assuming, तूर्णम् speedily, अमृतम् nectar, आहरत् had stolen.

40001380.author: Translation
40001380.content: When everything was destroyed completely, the exceedingly powerful Visnu assuming the form of Mohini a charming woman (elusive form) with the power of illusion quickly stole away the nectar.

40001381.author: पदार्थः
40001381.content: अक्षयम् imperishable, पुरुषोत्तमम् supreme purusha, विष्णुम् Vishnu, ये those, युद्धे in the battle, अभिमुखम् in front of him, गता: had gone, ते they, प्रभविष्णुना by the capable, विष्णुना by Vishnu, सम्पिष्टा: were grounded.

40001381.author: Translation
40001381.content: Those who opposed the imperishable, supreme purusha, Visnu, in the battle were crushed by all powerful Visnu.

40001382.author: पदार्थः
40001382.content: दैतेयादित्ययो: of the daityas and adityas, तस्मिन् in that, घोरे महायुद्धे great battle, वीरा: heroic, अदिते: Aditi's, आत्मजा: sons, दिते: Diti's, पुत्रान् sons, निजघ्निरे killed.

40001382.author: Translation
40001382.content: In that great and terrible battle between daityas and devatas, Aditi's sons killed Diti's.

40001383.author: पदार्थः
40001383.content: पुरन्दर: Indra, दितिपुत्रान् the sons of Diti, निहत्य having killed, राज्यम् kingdom, प्राप्य having gained, मुदित: pleased, सर्षिसङ्घान् in the company of rishis, सचारणान् celestial singers, लोकान् worlds, शशास ruled.

40001383.author: Translation
40001383.content: Indra, having killed the sons of Diti was happy with the kingdom gained. He ruled the worlds in the company of rishis and celestial singers". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे पञ्चचत्वारिंशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the fortyfifth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
